diagnosis: In all four rollouts, the lone decision-maker correctly assigned the monitoring kit to Rowan and set the monitoring duration and start date as specified. This led to Check C1 passing because the assignment and dates were consistent with the provided public facts, specifically PF1. Since PF1 was the only decisive fact that Check C1 depends on, and it was always accessible to the lone decision-maker, there is no evidence that Check C1 is unsatisfiable without the hidden information.

C1.why: The order changes the assignment from an open choice to Rowan and fixes the monitoring start, two daily blood-pressure readings, one daily weight reading, and exactly 14 days.
